kind: Trained synthetic spectral conditional neural generator

training.objective: Gaussian conditional negative log-likelihood, constant removed
training.context_sampling: half mode 2; half uniform modes 3 through 32
training.optimizer: Adam, learning rate 0.012, row norms projected to at most 1.3

validation.scope: simultaneously all 3 full-context fitted networks and modes 2..256
validation.method: bounded empirical Bernstein, union bound; synthetic conditional means are known

ablation.description: remove previous-band input; retrain on the same noisy field pairs
